settings.text:
§lEnchant+ costs§r
Per level: XP or Enchant Essence is paid for every enchantment level you add or transfer.
Flat: it is paid once per Enchant or Transfer, however many levels.
A Transfer costs half of what an Enchant would cost.
Disenchant gives part of the XP back; with a flat XP cost, only when it removes every enchantment.
Price calculator: syntaxghost404.github.io/Enchant-MCBE/guide/prices
